name: Fruit Slice
description: Swipe to slice flying fruit, chain combos and dodge the bombs.

description_i18n.en: Swipe to slice flying fruit, rack up combos, and dodge the bombs.

prompt: A swipe game like Fruit Ninja: fruits fly up from the bottom, swipe to slice them with a glowing blade trail, juice splashes, combos for slicing several at once, bombs that end the game, 3 lives, arcade and zen modes. author: gonzaroman
